refnamediv.refpurpose: Run Samba's python SMB tests against a SMB server

refsect1.title: DESCRIPTION
refsect1.para: pysmbtest runs the python SMB tests from Samba's test suite against an arbitrary SMB server, for example a Windows server, to compare its behaviour with Samba's. Samba's selftest runs these tests only against its own test servers.

The tests take the server, share and credentials from environment variables that selftest normally sets. pysmbtest sets them from its command line and runs the given tests with verbose unittest output.

Any number of tests can be specified on the command-line. A test is a python module, a test class or a single test method, for example libsmb-basic, libsmb_lock.Smb2LockTests or libsmb-basic.LibsmbTestCase.test_OpenClose. Names not starting with samba. are looked up below samba.tests.
--list lists all tests of classes derived from samba.tests.libsmb.LibsmbTests, one per line, in the form the command line takes.
The expected failures of Samba's selftest do not apply, every failing test is reported as such.

refsect2.title: UNC Format
refsect2.para: Backslashes work as well. All tests connect to this share, instead of the shares Samba's selftest provides.

listitem.para: Use the specified username/password combination as the default credentials for logging in to the server. Some tests replace them with their own selftest accounts, for example the ntacl_resource_attr_ace tests. Without a password, pysmbtest asks for it. Without a domain, the domain is empty.
Set the environment variable VAR for the tests. Some tests change their behaviour based on such variables, for example SMB1=1 makes the reparsepoints tests use SMB1. Can be given more than once.
List the available tests and exit.

refsect1.title: ENVIRONMENT
refsect1.para: pysmbtest sets these variables for the tests: SERVER and SERVER_IP from the server part of the UNC, SHARENAME, SMB1_SHARE, SMB2_SHARE and NOTIFY_SHARE from the share part, DOMAIN, USERNAME and PASSWORD from -U, and SMB_CONF_PATH and SERVERCONFFILE to an empty temporary smb.conf.

refsect1.title: LIMITATIONS
refsect1.para: Tests that look at the server's file system directly (they need LOCAL_PATH), or that need Samba-only features like the SMB1 UNIX extensions, SMB3 POSIX extensions or specially configured shares fail against other servers.
In the Samba build tree, run pysmbtest as bin/pysmbtest from the top directory.

refsect1.title: VERSION
refsect1.para: This man page is correct for version 4.26 of the Samba suite.
